build_MobileV2_MLSD_Tiny: build a MobileV2_MLSD_Tiny model instance for line segment detection on images
run_MobileNetV2_backbone: run the MobileNetV2 backbone to extract FPN features c2, c3, c4 from input
create_BlockTypeA_fusion: create a BlockTypeA module that fuses two feature maps with 1x1 convolutions and bilinear upsampling
create_BlockTypeB_residual: create a BlockTypeB module with residual connection and two 3x3 convolution blocks
create_BlockTypeC_dilated: create a BlockTypeC module with dilated convolution, regular convolution, and 1x1 output projection
